INTEGRATION SURFACES (layer 2 interfaces exposed by the vendor systems; what layer 3 domain services can be built on)
«Co7 API» Kobas API v3: REST, JSON, HTTPS only, pull only (catalogue read 6 Nov 2026: 77 endpoints, 11 groups)
Auth: OAuth2 client credentials, POST oauth.kobas.co.uk/access_token (client_id, client_secret, scope,
x-kobas-company-id); Bearer token + x-kobas-company-id on api.kobas.co.uk/v3
Groups: Customer (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, search, identity, voucher, meta, signup methods) · Discount (GET) · Gift Card
Reservation (GET/POST/PUT, status, note, payment, tag, source) · Staff (GET levels, roles, hours-worked, pay-details,
shifts) · Stock item / config (GET) · System option (GET)
Venue (GET /venue, GET /venue/payments: payment id, tab, order, customer, cash / card / other, gratuity, service
Integrations (GET /integrations/venue-sales: orders with items, lead type, discounts, tax, payments, consumption mode,
source; 1 h window max; GET cognos/till-order; Inn Style; Preoday; Yapster; wifi)
NOT in the API: no order or tab write, no payment write, no cash-log declare, no kitchen ticket, no webhooks. Orders
enter Kobas only through EPoS, QR and Deliverect. Cash log only via the /data reports (bot user)
Each endpoint used by a journey is drawn in its column below the «Co» boxes and linked (dashed orange) to the layer 3
«Co8 webhook» Slerp order webhook: push to a custom endpoint
Register under Integrations > Custom Webhooks (Zapier also supported). No event filter: all four types go to every
Order status PENDING > ACCEPTED > FULFILLED. Fulfilment, DELIVERY: PENDING > SEARCHING > PICKING > DELIVERING >
PICKUP: PENDING > PREPARING > READY_FOR_COLLECTION > COLLECTED. The two status fields advance on different schedules
Payload: id, type, createdAt; data.order: reference, status, customerDetails, recipientDetails, deliveryAddress,
deliveredAt), fulfillment (type, orderType, window), orderItems (sku, base, discounted, modifierGroups), summary
No payment object, no discount object (discount = base minus discounted, code not sent); signing and retries not
documented. Orders reach Kobas via Deliverect
«Co16 API» Trifft Loyalty Cloud API: Core API + Touchpoint API
Core API: Bearer token generated in the Content Cockpit. Touchpoint API: login returns JWT access + refresh token;
Member API: list, create, update, verify, ban / unban, anonymise, session tokens, referrals. Transaction API: create,
Wallets / points: add, deduct, set on primary or named wallets. Cards: get, assign, replace (Card API keyed by card
Also Batch (up to 500 requests per call), Segment, Booking, Product, Order, Content (news, deals, coupons, rewards,
Webhooks: under Integration Settings, no public reference. POS integration by guide (Zonal example). llms.txt index
lists every page and the OpenAPI endpoints
Maki today: Kobas venue meta_trifft_location_id and epos_loyalty_prompts; reward auto-applied as a Kobas discount;
Kobas customer carries loyalty cards, net_points
Candidate for CJ4 Loyalty member lifecycle: Member + Transaction + Wallet + Coupon are the layer 3 Loyalty Service

Vendor cloud: every component above is SaaS run by its vendor (Meta, Google, TikTok, Kobas, Slerp, Deliveroo, Deliverect, Dojo, Stripe, Xero, Trifft, Klaviyo). Data entities per vendor, see Ontology page.
5 landing page / UTM / closed loop: marketing to answer
